bad mode/origin/algorithm/client-auth settings
userinfo/query/fragment/control/alias URL rejection

case_groups.evidence_path: Private test process logs under workflow-artifacts/verification/private/b02-g3/; public ledger contains no DSN or token values.

case_groups.purpose: Verify signed issuer/subject/audience/nonce and strict NumericDate/azp/key/header handling using a locally generated RSA key and literal claim oracle.
normal_exception_boundary_regression: expiry equality and before/after
nbf/iat equality and future
non-finite/non-number claims
duplicate and multi-audience rules
wrong issuer/nonce/subject
unsupported algorithm, unknown key, private JWKS, unpublished signing key, untrusted jku
RSA oth private parameter rejected even when all other JWK fields are public
case_groups.expected_result: Only tokens matching the configured issuer, client, nonce, time policy and public signing key create an identity; rejected tokens do not create users or sessions.
case_groups.evidence_path: Pytest result and source-pinned G3 gate report; raw execution logs are private and captured by the parent runner.

case_groups.purpose: Check state/browser binding, consume-before-network one-use behavior, exact callback query parsing, bounded response egress and no redirect/decompression.
normal_exception_boundary_regression: valid optional issuer and session_state
cross-browser mismatch with rightful browser later completing
expired/equal transaction boundary
simultaneous callback race has exactly one winner
code/query length and UTF8/control/duplicate/unknown fields
65536-byte response accepted and chunked 65537-byte response rejected for token and JWKS
compression/redirect/non-success response rejection
provider error text suppression
literal HTTP-status/provider-error mapping: only invalid_grant at token endpoint 400/401 is AUTH_REQUIRED; other OAuth errors and malformed 200 are dependency failures
case_groups.expected_result: Callback state can be consumed once by the matching browser; failure responses remain fixed; the network client reaches only the configured token and JWKS endpoints and enforces the byte limit.
case_groups.evidence_path: Synthetic provider request counters and sanitized pytest assertions; private raw runner logs only.

case_groups.purpose: Verify opaque session persistence, literal HMAC CSRF, inactivity/absolute expiry, rotation, restart stability, commit ambiguity, and logout authorization.
normal_exception_boundary_regression: opaque 32-byte session stored only as hash
absolute expiration one microsecond before/equal boundary
rotation revokes old session and changes CSRF
same configured HMAC remains stable across app restart
precommit rollback vs postcommit uncertainty
logout requires live session, exact CSRF and exact Origin
case_groups.expected_result: A valid callback yields one opaque session and stable 43-character CSRF token; only current session plus valid CSRF and Origin revokes it; no cookie is emitted for an ambiguous commit.
case_groups.evidence_path: Isolated real PostgreSQL rows queried through the migration role; test command output retained privately by the parent runner.

case_groups.purpose: Check duplicate security headers/cookies, untrusted actor headers, exact Host/CORS, and actual Uvicorn callback canary absence.
normal_exception_boundary_regression: valid exact-origin preflight
invalid host/origin/method/header
duplicate cookie/authorization/origin/CSRF values
spoofed actor headers with and without a legitimate cookie
actual loopback Uvicorn valid callback, replay and provider error_description callback
case_groups.expected_result: Header spoofing never creates or overrides an actor; only allowlisted CORS receives credentials; actual Uvicorn stdout/stderr do not contain callback code, state, cookie, access token or provider error description.
case_groups.evidence_path: Private 0700 directory workflow-artifacts/verification/private/b02-g3/ with 0600 Uvicorn stdout/stderr files; config removed after shutdown.

case_groups.purpose: Verify bounded removal of only absolute-expired authentication material, exact expiry boundary, global login-state cap/admission race, cleanup progress on capacity rejection, and retrying lifespan maintenance with clean shutdown.
normal_exception_boundary_regression: expires_at <= trusted now deletes exactly; one-microsecond future login/session rows survive regardless consumed/revoked/idle flags
each maintenance call deletes at most1000 login rows and1000 session rows, then a second call makes remaining backlog progress
1023 login rows permit exactly one of two concurrent logins; second request at1024 is fixed503 without cookie or row
at full capacity with1001 expired plus1024 live rows, two rejected requests commit cleanup in1000 then1-row batches; after one live row is removed, a later request is admitted
background maintenance retries after a private DB exception, deletes expired row on next tick, logs no canary, and task is done at shutdown
case_groups.expected_result: Only absolute-expired auth rows are deleted; cap stays1024; denied requests never mint state/cookies; scheduler shutdown is awaited.
case_groups.evidence_path: Private targeted pytest captures and the frozen G3 service observation; no private DB identifiers or canaries in this ledger.
